title: CookieMonster schedule definition
description: Model-authored parameters for one schedule. The scheduler validates and persists this definition, and owns all IDs, timestamps, occurrence records and execution state separately.

name.description: Short display name for the saved schedule. Names are not unique identifiers.

prompt.description: Durable instructions submitted on every occurrence. Include the work, useful output, and any condition for stopping or requesting input. This text is not executable scheduler configuration.

execution.description: Execution requires the CookieMonster app and its local server to be running. This definition cannot request an OS service or cloud runner.

enabled.description: Whether future occurrences may be dispatched. Disabling does not interrupt or remove an already admitted prompt.

misfire.description: Treatment of occurrences missed while the app was unavailable, asleep, or explicitly paused. Never replay a backlog.

withinMinutes.description: Run only the latest missed occurrence when its scheduled instant is no older than this window. Advance past all other missed occurrences.

notification.description: Desktop notification policy. Failures-only includes sign-in and approval needs. Every occurrence remains visible in run history regardless of this setting.

maxRuns.description: Optional limit on occurrences with an admitted session prompt, including runs that later fail. Retries of the same occurrence do not consume another run; skipped occurrences do not count.

endsAt.description: Exclusive end instant. Do not admit work at or after this instant, including catch-up work. This does not interrupt an already admitted prompt.

instant.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit Z or numeric UTC offset. Validators must assert the date-time format.

sessionID.description: Existing session ID on this scheduler's local server. Resolve it before saving. Queue the prompt with delivery=queue; retain that session's location, agent and model.

directory.description: Absolute project directory on the local host: POSIX, Windows drive or UNC path. The scheduler must confirm availability before dispatch.

baseRef.description: Existing Git ref resolved to a commit at dispatch. Create a fresh managed worktree per occurrence without copying uncommitted changes. Treat this as data, never shell command text.

agent.description: Agent ID for new sessions. When omitted, capture the selected/default agent when saving the schedule.

model.description: Existing Model.Ref wire shape. When omitted, capture the selected/default model when saving the schedule. Never silently substitute an unavailable explicit model.

once.description: One occurrence at a fixed instant. Complete the schedule after that occurrence is admitted or permanently skipped.

interval.description: Occurrences at startsAt + n * everyMinutes for n >= 0. The anchor never resets on completion, restart or pause; intervals use elapsed time rather than local wall time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as Africa/Johannesburg, Europe/London or UTC. Runtime validation must reject unknown zones; abbreviations and numeric offsets are not timezone IDs.

time.description: Local wall-clock time in HH:mm, using the selected timezone.

weekdays.description: Local weekdays on which to run. Select all seven for a daily schedule.

calendar.description: One occurrence on each selected local day. Skip a nonexistent DST time; use the first instant of a repeated DST time and dispatch only once.
